# ENERGY STAR

> > The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency's program for energy efficiency certification, resources, and savings guidance across residential and commercial products and buildings.

ENERGY STAR helps consumers, businesses, and organizations save money and protect the environment through energy-efficient products, practices, and solutions. The program provides certification standards, expert guidance on home upgrades, information on tax credits and rebates, and tools for maximizing energy savings.

## Key Topics

- energy efficiency
- HVAC systems
- certified products
- tax credits and rebates
- home upgrades
- heating and cooling
- residential efficiency
- energy savings
- HVAC maintenance
- home comfort
- EPA certification standards

## Getting Started

- [Homepage | ENERGY STAR](https://www.energystar.gov): EPA's ENERGY STAR homepage for energy efficiency resources and savings

## HVAC Systems and Maintenance

- [How to Keep Your HVAC System Working Efficiently | ENERGY STAR](https://www.energystar.gov/products/ask-the-experts/how-to-keep-your-hvac-system-working-efficiently): Expert guide on maintaining HVAC systems for energy efficiency and cost savings
